m: पर्ष् (cf. पृष्) cl. 1. Ā. पर्षते, to grow wet, Dhātup. xvi, 12 (v.l. वर्ष् and स्पर्ष्).
a: पर्ष् — {c1c} A. (पर्षते) 1 To become wet or moist. --2 Ved. To accept.

s: Na snehe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM-AtmaMakaM-sew .) rePopaDaH । sneha iha ArdrIBAvaH । Na, parzate payasA pawaH । sparza iti caturBujaH । sparzate pasparze । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: snehe BvA॰ Atma॰ saka॰ sew । parzate aparzizWa papa
m: 1. पर्ष m. (√ पर्ष्, पृष् ?) a bundle, sheaf, RV. x, 48, 7 (Nir. iii, 10).
2. पर्ष mfn. = परुष, rough, violent (as wind), BhP.
1. पर्षणि mfn. (√ 1. पृ) carrying over or across (as a ship), RV. i, 131, 2.
2. पर्षणि Ved. inf. of √ 1. पृ, ib. x, 126, 3.

v: strI pfza--adi । 1 saBAyAm 2 DarmopadeSakapiRqatasamAje ca । tataH astyarTe valac । parzadvala saBAsade tri hemaca॰ ।
m: पर्षद् f. = परि-षद्, an assembly, audience, company, society, GṛS.; Yājñ. &c. (4 kinds of society, Divyāv. 299, 14).
a: पर्षद् — f. [पृस्-अदि] 1 An assembly, a meeting, conclave. --2 Particularly, a religious synod or assembly; Y. 1. 9.

m: पर्षद्—भीरु mfn. shy in society, Var.

s: tri, (parzat saBA vidyate yasya । parzat + “rajaHkfzIti .” 5 । 2 । 112 । iti valac .) pArizadaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, BawwiH । 4 । 12 । “vrAtInavyAladIptAstraH sutvanaH paripUjayan । parzadvalAn mahAbrahmErAwa nEkawikASramAn ॥”)
m: पर्षद्—वल mfn. surrounded by an assembly, Pāṇ. v, 2, 112, Sch.
पर्षद्—वल m. an assistant at an assembly, a spectator, L.
